name: paysera-checkout
description: Build a Paysera Checkout integration: Checkout Modern payments with the PHP SDK or REST, verified webhooks, safe refunds with Idempotency-Key, payment links and Test Mode. Writes the merchant's code; holds no credentials and calls no API itself.

interface.longDescription: Helps you build a Paysera Checkout Modern integration: orders, payment links, verified webhooks, refunds with idempotency keys and Test Mode, with PHP SDK and REST examples.
